Both schedules are TYPED; only the cover is handwritten, and no figure was taken from the cover. THE SCHEDULES ARE CUMULATIVE, NOT PERIOD-SCOPED: both cover This-Report cells are a handwritten 0, both Cumulative cells equal their Totals-from-Last-Report cells, and each schedule restates the entire cycle back to January — dates run 1/2/2024 to 10/2/2024 on a report whose own window is October 4-23. This filing therefore SUPERSETS the same candidate's earlier 2024 report (key ec26f2c2, pages 8-10) rather than continuing it: five of its six expenditure rows and two of its three contribution rows are the same entries, re-itemized, and a cycle rollup must count this candidate ONCE, from the latest non-superseded report.
